---
title: "rtichoke single browser summary report acceptance"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: false
---

<iframe id="report-one" src="summary-report-one.html" style="width:100%;height:1800px;border:0"></iframe>
<div id="acceptance-status" data-ready="false"></div>

<script>
(() => {
  const status = document.querySelector("#acceptance-status");
  const frame = document.querySelector("#report-one");

  function poll() {
    const doc = frame.contentDocument;
    if (doc) {
      const component = id => doc.querySelector(`[data-component-id="${id}"]`);
      const table = component("performance-table")?.querySelector("table.rtichoke-performance-table__table");
      const ppcrTable = component("performance-table-2")?.querySelector("table.rtichoke-performance-table__table");
      const discreteCalibration = component("calibration")?.querySelector("svg");
      const precisionRecall = component("precision-recall")?.querySelector("svg");
      const decisionCurve = component("decision-curve")?.querySelector("svg");
      const interventionsAvoided = component("interventions-avoided")?.querySelector("svg");
      const report = doc.querySelector(".rtichoke-report");
      const cssLoaded = Array.from(doc.styleSheets).some(sheet =>
        (sheet.href || "").includes("rtichoke-viz-0.20.1/rtichoke-viz.css")
      );
      const styled = report && getComputedStyle(report).display !== "none";
      function testTableDisclosure(tableNode, expectedOpType) {
        if (!tableNode) return false;
        const toggleBtn = tableNode.querySelector(".rtichoke-performance-table__toggle-btn");
        const detailRow = tableNode.querySelector(".rtichoke-performance-table__detail-row");
        const detailContainer = tableNode.querySelector(".rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-container");
        const titleNode = detailContainer?.querySelector(".rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-title");

        if (!toggleBtn || !detailRow || !detailContainer || !titleNode) return false;

        const initialCollapsed = detailRow.hidden === true && toggleBtn.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "false";
        const titleCorrect = titleNode.textContent.trim() === "Confusion Matrix";
        const opTypeCorrect = detailContainer.getAttribute("data-operating-point-type") === expectedOpType;
        const opValCorrect = !!detailContainer.getAttribute("data-operating-point-value");

        if (!initialCollapsed || !titleCorrect || !opTypeCorrect || !opValCorrect) return false;

        toggleBtn.click();

        const expandedVisible = detailRow.hidden === false && toggleBtn.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";

        return expandedVisible;
      }

      const threshDisclosureOk = testTableDisclosure(component("performance-table"), "probability_threshold");
      const ppcrDisclosureOk = testTableDisclosure(component("performance-table-2"), "ppcr");

      if (table && ppcrTable && discreteCalibration && precisionRecall && decisionCurve && interventionsAvoided && cssLoaded && styled && threshDisclosureOk && ppcrDisclosureOk) {
        status.dataset.ready = "true";
        status.dataset.table = "true";
        status.dataset.ppcrTable = "true";
        status.dataset.discreteCalibration = "true";
        status.dataset.precisionRecall = "true";
        status.dataset.decisionCurve = "true";
        status.dataset.interventionsAvoided = "true";
        status.dataset.css = "true";
        status.dataset.threshDisclosure = "true";
        status.dataset.ppcrDisclosure = "true";
        return;
      }
    }
    setTimeout(poll, 100);
  }

  poll();
})();
</script>
